instruments.title: Open Everyday living and independence reflection
instruments.description: An independently written, free-to-use reflection guide for adaptive skills. It is not the named proprietary instrument and is not a validated substitute.
instruments.intendedUse: Self-reflection and preparation for a conversation with a qualified professional only. Not diagnostic, norm-referenced, or validated for clinical decisions.
